theme.name: Sage & Gold Garden
theme.summary: An outdoor garden ceremony in sage and gold: olive branches, soft vines, warm gold light.

bridesmaids.name: Breanna
bridesmaids.rationale: Breanna dresses to be seen. With her hair up, statement earrings frame her face. The olive leaves tie her to the group while the cascading, sculptural shape matches her boldness.
bridesmaids.prompt: bold sculptural drop earrings made of layered olive leaves cascading downward, substantial and eye-catching, polished high-shine finish. Made in 14k Gold Vermeil. Garden wedding bridesmaid jewelry inspired by olive leaves, climbing vines, tiny garden blossoms; romantic garden formal style. Her personal style: loves bold statement pieces and sculptural shapes, wears her hair up in a gele for formal events.
bridesmaids.title: 14k Gold Vermeil Dangle Earring

bridesmaids.name: Litzy
bridesmaids.rationale: Litzy rarely wears jewelry and will never wear anything loud. A single tiny leaf stud carries the garden theme in its quietest form, and she can wear it every day after the wedding.
bridesmaids.prompt: tiny minimalist stud earrings, each a single small olive leaf in clean simplified geometric lines, smooth polished finish. Made in 14k Gold Vermeil. Garden wedding bridesmaid jewelry inspired by olive leaves, climbing vines, tiny garden blossoms; romantic garden formal style. Her personal style: minimalist, clean lines, everyday wear, prefers tiny understated pieces.

bridesmaids.name: Sarah
bridesmaids.rationale: Sarah collects vintage pieces. A filigree medallion feels like an heirloom, and the vines and blossom put the shared garden motif in her ornate, romantic style.
bridesmaids.prompt: vintage heirloom-style oval medallion pendant necklace with intricate filigree olive vines and a tiny blossom at the center. Made in 14k Gold Vermeil. Garden wedding bridesmaid jewelry inspired by olive leaves, climbing vines, tiny garden blossoms; romantic garden formal style. Her personal style: romantic and vintage-inspired, loves ornate filigree and heirloom-looking pieces.

bridesmaids.name: Tinuke
bridesmaids.rationale: Tinuke stacks rings on every finger. A vine band that wraps the finger reads as part of the garden, and she can stack it with her own rings so it fits her layered, organic look.
bridesmaids.prompt: delicate organic band ring shaped like a twisting olive vine wrapping around the finger with small leaves, hand-textured natural look. Made in 14k Gold Vermeil. Garden wedding bridesmaid jewelry inspired by olive leaves, climbing vines, tiny garden blossoms; romantic garden formal style. Her personal style: boho and nature-loving, stacks lots of delicate rings, organic textures.
